propositions: s3_doctor._git calls gitutil.run_git directly without retry wrapper, causing transient object-DB read failures to be fatal while the same fault class self-heals in other store write paths
Three CI test runs (31340000912, 31349549323, 31558315198) failed identically with 'fatal: bad object HEAD' during bundle creation, indicating a missing merge commit object at bundle time
The exact failure signature and experimental reproduction by deleting the merge commit object before bundling proves the mechanism: an object was unreadable from the ODB, not corrupt or unborn
s3_doctor._git must route through gitutil.run_git_write to inherit the per-store advisory git-op lock, bounded index/ref-lock retry, and transient read-fault retry
The 'bad object' signature must be added to the existing transient marker family in gitutil so the proven missing-object class self-heals without a new retry loop
S3DoctorConflict error hints misdescribe an ODB read failure as a heads conflict, sending operators to the wrong tool when a merge never conflicted
